description: This header file defines template classes for B-tree based set and multiset containers (`absl::btree_set` and `absl::btree_multiset`) that are optimized replacements for `std::set` and `std::multiset`. It includes class definitions, member functions, and internal policies for managing B-tree nodes, as well as utility functions like swap and erase_if.

classes.name: absl::btree_set
classes.description: A template class implementing a B-tree based ordered set of unique keys, designed as a more efficient alternative to `std::set`.

classes.name: absl::btree_multiset
classes.description: A template class implementing a B-tree based multiset allowing duplicate keys, as a more efficient alternative to `std::multiset`.

classes.name: set_slot_policy
classes.description: Internal policy struct defining how to construct, destroy, and access elements in the B-tree nodes for set/multiset.

classes.name: set_params
classes.description: Template struct holding configuration parameters for the B-tree set/multiset, including key, compare, allocator, node size, and whether it is multi.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents of two B-tree set/multiset containers.

methods.name: erase_if
methods.description: Erases all elements satisfying a predicate from the container, returning the count of erased elements.
